info.description: Private staff inspection, evidence, recorded review history, fixed-reference diagnostics, eligible-Bank stock rehearsals, canonical dataset preflight, author handoff, rejection, and quarantine operations for the local synthetic runtime. Never include this contract in student bundles; authentication and access checks remain runtime-enforced.
info.title: TSA Platform private staff API contracts

post.description: Requires a current EXAM_MANAGER principal with the existing exam.assembly.write permission, the trusted same-origin staff session, a CSRF token, and an idempotency key. The strict JSON body pins one exact supported one-domain blueprint and capture window; omitted seed stays omitted in the parsed body and the server uses seed 42. The body is limited to 1 MiB. Success returns the immutable historical seal receipt only; it creates no student attempt, assignment, score, release, or student-delivery capability.
